```{r load packages, echo = FALSE}
# reorder the samples in the metadata to appear in the order desired by us
mg_cond_levels <- factor(c("A","B", "C", "D","E", "F", "G","H", "I", "J"))
# generate color palette based on vintage_cols palette
col_sample <-setNames(c(c("#002C3D","#03707E", "#65c1be", "#5F6C25", "#BBA834", "#E7A624", "#CA6702", "#C33708", "#971E1C", "#A74E8D")), mg_cond_levels)

# reorder the samples in the metadata to appear in the order desired by us
mg_primary_ct_levels <- factor(c("Homeostatic microglia (early)", "Homeostatic microglia (late)", "Activated microglia", "Proliferating microglia", "SOX-medium microglia", "SOX-hi microglia", "Monocyte", "Perivascular macrophage", "Erythrocyte"))
# generate color palette based on vintage_cols palette
col_primary_ct <-setNames(c(rev(rainbow_pastel_cols(9))), mg_primary_ct_levels)

```

```{r load seurat object}

# load microglia conditions
seurat <- readRDS("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Protocol_optimization/seurat_integrated.rds")

# Kracht et al 2020 microglia
seurat_MG <- readRDS("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Co-culture_timecourse/Kracht_primary_microglia_seurat.rds")
# subset only clear microglia cells from the kracht dataset - exclude erythrocyte, monocyte, perivascular macrophage and sox-hi microglia
seurat_MG_only <- subset(seurat_MG, subset = celltype %in% c("Homeostatic microglia (early)", "Homeostatic microglia (late)", "Activated microglia", "Proliferating microglia", "SOX-medium microglia")) %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000) 
seurat_MG_only$condition <- "primary"

```
Integrate the primary and in vitro data
```{r integration}

# select features that are repeatedly variable across datasets for integration
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = c(seurat, seurat_MG_only), fvf.nfeatures = 3000)

# integrate
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = c(seurat, seurat_MG_only), anchor.features = features)

# this command creates an 'integrated' data assay
integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors)

```

Integrated analysis
```{r integrated analysis}

# specify that we will perform downstream analysis on the corrected data note that the
# original unmodified data still resides in the 'RNA' assay
DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "integrated"

# Run the standard workflow for visualization and clustering
integrated <- ScaleData(integrated, verbose = FALSE) %>%
        RunPCA(npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE) %>%
        RunUMAP(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30) %>%
        FindNeighbors(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30) %>%
        FindClusters(resolution = 0.5) %>%
        FindClusters(resolution = 0.3)

# Visualization
p1 <- DimPlot(integrated, reduction = "umap", group.by = "condition", cols = rev(rainbow_pastel_cols(11)))
p2 <- DimPlot(integrated, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE)
p1 + p2

DimPlot(integrated, reduction = "umap", group.by = "condition", cols = rev(rainbow_pastel_cols(11)), split.by = "condition")

```

#### DE analysis
Find DE genes
```{r}

# For performing differential expression after integration, we switch back to the original
# data
DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "RNA"
Idents(integrated) <- "condition"
# Find differentially expressed features between each condition and the priamry cells
# A vs primary
markers.A <- wilcoxauc(integrated, group_by = "condition", groups_use = c("A", "primary")) %>%
  filter(group == "A") %>%
  mutate(DE = abs(logFC)>log(1.5) & padj < 0.01) %>%
  mutate(DEG = ifelse(abs(logFC)>log(1.5) & padj < 0.01, feature, NA))
markers.A <- markers.A %>% 
  mutate(outcome = case_when(logFC > log(1.5) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Up-regulated",
                           logFC < -log(1.5) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Down-regulated",
                           TRUE ~ "Unchanged"))
write.csv(markers.A, "Plots/Protocol_optimization/wicoaux_DEGs_A_vs_primary.csv")

# B vs primary

# plot
# A vs primary
pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/volcano_DE_A_vs_primary.pdf", height = 5, width = 8)
ggplot(markers.A, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(padj),label=DEG)) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2, aes(fill=factor(outcome)), position = "jitter") +
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-log(1.5), log(1.5), 0),  linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(1), linetype="dotted") +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#58B6AC", "gray50", "#C73E04")) +
  xlab(expression("log"[2]*"FC")) + 
  ylab(expression("-log"[10]*"p_adj")) + 
  ggtitle("DEGs condition A vs. primary microglia")
dev.off()
```
